question: Under what temporal condition is old age and death claimed to be destroyed?
premises: Practice is carried out for one year.
When that practice has been done, a condition holds.
Under that condition old age and death are destroyed.
inference: When practice has been carried out for one year, old age and death are claimed to be destroyed.
uncertainties: The nature of the practice is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: When practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
